summary: The ground shakes as a kinetic penetrator dropped by Cyrus hits the desert floor a mile away, sending a massive wall of dust toward the camp. Milo scrambles into the driver’s seat of the launch tanker, his hands fumbling with the oversized iron gear shift as the entire cabin rattles violently. In the distance, Cyrus stands atop his armored interceptor vehicle, watching through a thermal scope as the scavengers try to flee the impact zone. Milo slams the lever forward with both hands, his face contorted with the effort of fighting the seized mechanical components. "Shift the gears manually before the transmission grinds itself into useless, red-hot iron dust."

summary: Arvin and Milo crouch inside the skeletal remains of a derelict hauler under the blistering midday sun. Arvin brushes thick orange dust off a titanium fuel valve, his fingers tracing the hairline fractures in the metal while Milo pulls a heavy wrench from his belt and taps the casing, listening for the density of the alloy. The sun beats down through the gaps in the overhead metal, casting sharp, zebra-striped shadows across their sweat-slicked faces as they evaluate the salvage. "This valve is the only thing keeping us from becoming a crater," Arvin says while tightening a weathered bolt with his bare hand.

summary: Inside the humid, cramped belly of the tanker, Arvin secures a row of mismatched copper pipes while Lucia watches from the narrow doorway, holding a canister of high-volatile propellant. She steps over a heap of discarded wiring, her boots crunching on the grit-covered floor, and holds the canister out toward him like a silent challenge. Arvin wipes grease onto his thigh and stares at the chemical seal, his jaw tightening as he refuses to reach for the dangerous fuel. "If you pour that poison into my lines, the seals will melt before we clear the ridge," Arvin says, his eyes locked on Lucia’s unwavering hand.
